subject: science
concept: Identifying the limiting reactant in a chemical reaction
source_inspiration: original content — not sourced from any external text

exercise.concrete: Student combines two physical reactant sets in unequal amounts and observes which runs out first, limiting the reaction
exercise.pictorial: Student matches a set of given reactant amounts to which one is the limiting reactant
exercise.abstract: Student identifies the limiting reactant and calculates the maximum product possible from a given reaction

misconception_flags: assumes the reactant present in the smallest raw quantity is automatically the limiting reactant, without accounting for the mole ratio
